question: Can you help me find the top 5 countries whose players have the highest average of their individual average runs per match across all seasons? Specifically, for each player, calculate their average runs per match over all matches they played, then compute the average of these player averages for each country, and include these country batting averages in the result.

WITH player_ball_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        pm.player_id,
        bb.match_id,
        bb.innings_no,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) as runs_in_match
    FROM player_match pm
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON pm.match_id = bb.match_id AND bb.innings_no = bb.innings_no
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE pm.player_id = bb.striker
    GROUP BY pm.player_id, bb.match_id, bb.innings_no
),
player_innings AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        pm.player_id,
        pm.match_id,
        bb.innings_no
    FROM player_match pm
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON pm.match_id = bb.match_id
    WHERE pm.player_id = bb.striker
),
player_extra_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        pi.player_id,
        pi.match_id,
        SUM(er.extra_runs) as extra_runs
    FROM player_innings pi
    JOIN extra_runs er ON pi.match_id = er.match_id AND pi.innings_no = er.innings_no
    GROUP BY pi.player_id, pi.match_id
),
player_total_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        pbr.player_id,
        pbr.match_id,
        COALESCE(pbr.runs_in_match, 0) + COALESCE(per.extra_runs, 0) as total_runs
    FROM player_ball_runs pbr
    FULL OUTER JOIN player_extra_runs per ON pbr.player_id = per.player_id AND pbr.match_id = per.match_id
),
player_match_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) as match_count,
        SUM(total_runs) as total_runs_all_matches,
        SUM(total_runs) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) as avg_runs_per_match
    FROM player_total_runs
    WHERE player_id IS NOT NULL AND match_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY player_id
),
player_country_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        p.country_name,
        pms.avg_runs_per_match
    FROM player_match_stats pms
    JOIN player p ON pms.player_id = p.player_id
)
SELECT 
    country_name,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_runs_per_match), 2) as avg_of_player_averages
FROM player_country_avg
GROUP BY country_name
ORDER BY avg_of_player_averages DESC
LIMIT 5
